rows.predicate_description: after global preemption, no eligible nondegenerate underlying context exists in a source/kind required by the estimand, or at least one seed block of the fixed twenty-seed census contains no eligible nondegenerate underlying context for a required source/kind

on a nonvacuous primary estimand, either a named sensitivity has the frozen strict unrounded sign reversal, or a mandatory named sensitivity point estimate or required sensitivity interval is not evaluable because its prescribed aggregation or resampling has an empty required spectral population under this convention
both kinds have lower bound >1/240, adjusted margin-test p<=0.05, and no sensitivity reversal
both kinds have lower bound >0 and at least one lower bound <=1/240
both intervals lie inside [-1/240,1/240] and at least one includes zero
both kinds have upper bound <0, no upper bound <-1/240, and kinds are not mixed
